summaryDeep: Their questions, explanations, and way of talking work smoothly with your feelings, needs, and sense of safety. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
tension: The challenge is that ease can make you lazy with honesty. You may assume they already know what you feel. They may assume you will say it if it matters. But even natural understanding needs real information.
advice: Keep telling the truth in real time. Let the conversation stay alive. The gift here is not just that this person understands you. It is that the two of you can keep learning how to understand each other more deeply.
